Pool the per-quadrat metadata of each small-tree plot into one row

dot-collapse_small_tree_plots.Rd

plot.xlsx describes every quadrat, a plot row holds one value per column. The rules:

  • plot_area is the number of quadrats times quadrat_area;

  • quadrats lists the quadrat labels in firsttag order;

  • the date is the earliest of the quadrats;

  • team_leader, additional_people and identified_by pool the people of every quadrat;

  • forest_type and forest_state pool their values;

  • any other column keeps its first non-missing value.

A plot whose quadrats disagree on its date or on a column of the last kind is announced, naming the values found.

Usage

.collapse_small_tree_plots(
  per_quadrat,
  quadrats,
  quadrat_area = NULL,
  relation = "nested_subsample"
)

Arguments

per_quadrat

Plot metadata with one row per quadrat, keyed by quadrat_unit.

quadrats

Quadrat units (quadrat_unit, plot_name, parent_plot_name, quadrat, firsttag).

quadrat_area

Area of one quadrat in hectares, or NULL.

relation

Value written to parent_relation.

Value

Data frame with one row per small-tree plot: plot_name, parent_plot_name, parent_relation, quadrats, plot_area (when quadrat_area is given), then the pooled metadata columns.
